user_facts.content: A natural disaster caused the world's leading GPU manufacturer to lose 60% of production capacity, with full recovery expected by the end of 2028 through subsidiary investments.
The European automotive industry is slow to adopt EV production, leading to a flood of cheap East Asian EVs and projected profits at 30% of 2020-2024 average in 2025.
Eurozone countries' GDP is projected to fall by an average of 1.5% in 2025 compared to 2024.
A fragile ceasefire holds in eastern Ukraine, with Russia controlling two major power plants. The Ukrainian economy is growing at 4% GDP, driven by defense and infrastructure investments.
US investments in Ukraine target critical raw materials in the mining industry. Annual EU investments in Ukraine are 3% of Ukrainian GDP and will remain at this level until 2029.

A sharp increase in renewable energy in the EU and China from early 2028, combined with a mid-2023 discovery of huge oil and gas deposits in South America, will lead to an oversupply of fuels and a significant drop in oil prices to 30-35 USD per barrel by late 2027, impacting Russia's budget.
